citations.claim: first energy_bound violation: total energy jumps well above allowed bound
just before impact speed matches initial energy-conserving flight
after wall bounce speed is much larger than incoming speed despite e=1 with no controller work

counterfactual.change: Changed bodies[0].e from 1 to 0 only; inelastic impact dissipates the spurious corner-bounce energy injection so no energy_bound violation occurs.

explanation: With e=1 and no controller work, energy should be conserved, but a high-speed (~59) impact against the thin vertical wall injects energy: speed grows from ~58.85 at step 4 to ~66.7 at step 5 and energy from ~1817 to ~2310. The body approaches the wall's side/edge region and the impulse plus positional correction over-corrects, reversing vx and spuriously boosting vy (from -16.15 to +53.78), i.e. a corner/sequential-impulse energy gain. Setting e=0 removes the gain and the run passes.
vision_note: Across steps 2 to 4 the ball moves toward the top corner of the thin vertical wall from its upper left. At step 5 it arrives exactly at the top edge-corner of the wall in a grazing side-corner contact.
